title: Villuveleni Na Jeevitham – Vinod Kumar, Benjamin Telugu Christian Lyrics

jeevame leni nalo nee jeevamunu nimputaku
enni yugalaina maradhu – yendina prathi modunu
marala chigurinchunu – na devuniki samasthamu sadhyame

credits.Vocals: Pastor Vinod Kumar, Pastor Benjamin Johnson and Christ Alone Music Team

intro: Villuveleni Na Jeevitham is the latest Telugu Christian song written and tuned by Pastor Vinod Kumar, sung by Pastor Vinod Kumar and Pastor Benjamin Johnson and music composed by Moses Dany. This song was released on December 09, 2021 through Pastor Vinod Kumar YouTube channel.
